macro_views: OpenRAM TT_1p8V_25C at every corner (no other corner characterized)

hold_violators.path: register to register inside the SPI frame buffer

analysis: OpenROAD's STA on the routed database with the extracted SPEF. The typical corner reproduces ORFS's own final report (setup WNS +4.893 ns, hold WNS +0.119 ns). An earlier analysis that read 6_final.v instead left about 4,300 nets without parasitics, because ORFS omits the antenna diodes from that netlist while the SPEF refers to them.
note: Flip-flop-to-flip-flop paths are analysed at all three corners; paths through the SRAM macros use their typical-corner views everywhere, so the slow- and fast-corner results for those paths are not meaningful.
